title: tui: calculateTotal missing — truncation notice never fires
description:
load_messages_for_chat sends Message/query without calculateTotal:true. The server (kith-chat/src/message.rs:786) only emits a numeric total when calculateTotal is true; otherwise total is null. Value::as_u64() on null returns None → unwrap_or(ids.len()) → total_on_server == ids.len() → check is always false. The truncation notice added in loop 1 never fires against a real kithd.

Fix: add calculateTotal:true to the Message/query request in load_messages_for_chat.
